name: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

meta.start: Marshal Dughan,Guard Thomas,Deputy Rainer,Farmer Furlbrow, orFarmer Saldean

summary: Westfall needs fighters, and Report to Gryan Stoutmantle sends you to answer the call. The crown leaves the outer farmlands to fend for themselves, so local defenders gather under Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill.

sections.title: A Plea Across the River
sections.body: Westfall calls for skilled fighters from across the river. Brigands, gnolls, and hostile harvest golems are driving the farmlands into chaos. With no royal battalions answering, local volunteers must defend the realm.

sections.title: Sentinel Hill and the Militia
sections.body: The road leads you to Gryan Stoutmantle in the stone tower atop Sentinel Hill. He leads the People's Militia, a force of farmers, retired veterans, and mercenaries formed in response to royal inaction. The farmlands face a bitter guerrilla war against lawlessness.

faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle is a veteran fighter who commands the People's Militia. He organizes Westfall's defenses from the tower atop Sentinel Hill and gathers fighters to protect its farmers from bandits and beasts.

faq.q: Why is the People's Militia needed?
faq.answer: The People's Militia is needed because the Stormwind army has turned its attention to the capital, leaving Westfall with little crown support. Residents formed the militia to defend themselves from bandits, rogue harvest automatons, and marauding Riverpaw gnolls.
Sentinel Hill lies near the center of Westfall, along the main road. Its sturdy stone watchtower and fortified camp are gathering places for the People's Militia.

faq.q: Who sends adventurers on this assignment?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan in Goldshire, border guards such as Guard Thomas and Deputy Rainer, and displaced farmers such as Farmer Furlbrow and Farmer Saldean refer capable fighters to Gryan.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Gryan?
faq.answer: When you report to Stoutmantle, he puts your fighting skill to work for the People's Militia. Your first assignments target the Defias brigands and gnolls threatening Westfall.

faq.q: Is Westfall technically still part of the Alliance?
faq.answer: Yes. Westfall remains Alliance territory under the nominal authority of the Stormwind Kingdom. The crown's garrison neglects the province, leaving armed citizens to defend it.

angles.text: As a human of the kingdom, you see the divide between Stormwind City's safe marble streets and the harsh, neglected farmlands beyond.
As an Alliance member, you see ordinary citizens forming militias to survive while the royal court argues over politics in Stormwind.
As a warrior, you bring the seasoned discipline Gryan Stoutmantle values, making you an important fighter for the outnumbered People's Militia.
